title: VisualReconstructionSpec
description: Schema for structured UI reconstruction specifications produced from visual references

componentName.description: Identifier or title of the UI section or component being reconstructed

layoutHierarchy.description: Tree structure representing spatial layout (e.g. root container, grid/flex arrangement, flow direction)

observedFacts.description: Empirically verified visual facts (e.g. 'Navbar contains 4 navigation links', 'Primary button has solid blue background and white text')

uncertainties.description: Explicit record of unverified visual aspects requiring assumptions or runtime testing

typographyScale.description: Observed relative font sizes, weights, and line heights
